definition: to go and see someone at their home
description: A misty sea cliff covered in pink sea thrift flowers. A young woman with a long black braid, an olive waxed jacket and rubber boots stands on the narrow path holding a wicker basket and reaches up to touch the nose of a huge grey-green dragon. The dragon's horned, scaly head leans out of a cave in the cliff face, lowers and rubs gently against her cheek while she laughs with her eyes closed. A wooden walking stick lies on the path, and rocky islands sit in the grey sea below.
